attempted_claim: Let X=Z(P^3 x Gr(2,7), O(0,1)^{oplus 2} + O(1,1) + Q_{P^3} boxtimes U^vee_{Gr(2,7)}) be a general member of family R-62 in Bernardara-Fatighenti-Manivel-Tanturri (Picard rank 2, (-K_X)^4=129, h^{3,1}=1), realized as a conic bundle pi_1:X->P^3 with discriminant a 16-nodal quintic surface plus a small contraction of a P^2 by pi_2. Does X admit a multiplicative Chow-Kunneth (MCK) decomposition in the sense of Shen-Vial, and hence does the intersection product CH^1(X) tensor CH^2(X) -> CH^3(X) have 2-dimensional image spanned by distinguished 1-cycles and injecting into cohomology under the cycle class map?
decisive_failure: Target-only lane with no preset fallback. Exact torus-localization plus HRR computations verified the cohomological shadow of the target ((-K)^4=129, chi_top=31, Hodge diamond with h^{1,2}=0 and h^{2,2}=23, ambient product image spanning the 2-dimensional H^6), but the Chow-level multiplicativity and rational-equivalence core of MCK for family R-62 is unreachable with bounded in-pass means: construction needs a nonexistent family program and disproof has no motivic foothold given H^odd=0. Working scripts retained alongside this report.
